title: Q-Learning under Finite Model Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2407.04259v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose a robust Q-learning algorithm for Markov decision processes under model uncertainty when each state--action pair is associated with a finite ambiguity set of candidate transition kernels. This finite-measure framework enables user-designed uncertainty models, including competing fitted models and stress scenarios. {The learner observes successor states and their deterministic rewards from every candidate simulator, without requiring explicit knowledge of the transition probabilities or the reward function.} We establish almost sure convergence of the learned Q-function to the robust optimum, and derive a time-uniform high-probability error certificate that separates an observable empirical Bellman residual from transition-kernel estimation error. translated_title: 有限模型不确定性下的Q学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种面向模型不确定性下马尔可夫决策过程的鲁棒Q学习算法，其中每个状态-动作对都关联着一个由候选转移核构成的有限模糊集。这一有限测度框架支持用户自定义的不确定性模型，包括相互竞争的拟合模型以及压力情景。学习者从每个候选模拟器中观察后继状态及其确定性奖励，而无需显式知晓转移概率或奖励函数。我们证明了所学习的Q函数几乎必然收敛到鲁棒最优解，并推导出一个时间一致的高概率误差证书，该证书将可观测的经验贝尔曼残差与转移核估计误差分离开来。我们还针对有限状态空间上的Wasserstein不确定性模型和参数化不确定性模型，给出了定量的有限模糊逼近结果。数值算例说明了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 提出了一种在有限模糊转移核集合下的鲁棒Q学习算法，证明了其几乎必然收敛到鲁棒最优解，并给出将可观测经验贝尔曼残差与转移核估计误差分离的时间一致高概率误差界。
en_tdlr: A robust Q-learning algorithm is proposed for MDPs with finite ambiguity sets of candidate transition kernels, establishing almost-sure convergence to the robust optimum and a time-uniform high-probability error certificate that separates the observable empirical Bellman residual from transition-kernel estimation error.
